title: 上海高考高分翻译背诵-133-25二模

items.zh: 这条骑行路线沿海岸线绵延约560公里,提供多种难度级别。
items.en: Along the coastline, the biking route stretches approximately 560 kilometers, offering various difficulty levels.

items.zh: 人性化的设计和功能使这些环保型家居用品备受欢迎。
items.en: What makes these environmentally-friendly home products popular is their human-centered design and functionality.

items.zh: 更新后的招生政策彰显了这所大学在提升学生群体质量和多样性上的不懈努力。
items.en: Updated admissions policies are evidence that the university has made unremitting efforts to improve the quality and diversity of its student body.

items.zh: 恰如古语所云,未曾领略冬之凛冽,无法感知春之和煦,这体现了冬去春来、季节交替的真谛。
items.en: True to the old saying, without experiencing the chill of winter, one cannot sense the warmth of spring—a truth to which the changing of the seasons corresponds.
